root_cause.text: In xfrm6_rcv_encap(), a dst entry obtained from ip6_route_input_lookup() is not released when dst->error is set, causing a reference leak on every packet that hits this error path.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds dst_release(dst) before the goto drop when dst->error is true, and the commit message explicitly states that the lookup returns a referenced dst even on error and that the missing release causes dst entry leaks.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a dst reference leak in xfrm6_rcv_encap by releasing the dst when route lookup returns an error.
intent_record.what: Added dst_release(dst) call in the error handling branch when dst->error is true, before goto drop.
intent_record.how: Prevents a reference leak of the dst structure by releasing it when route lookup fails, ensuring proper resource cleanup.

This statement acquires a reference to a dst entry via route lookup, which must be released later; the leak occurs because the reference is not released on error.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement acquires a reference to a dst entry via route lookup. The reference must be released later, but on error it is not, causing a leak.
This condition checks for an error in the dst entry. When true, it directs to the drop label without releasing the dst reference, leading to the leak.
This statement jumps to the drop label, bypassing the necessary dst_release call that would have freed the acquired reference, thus leaking it on every packet hitting this error path.
